messages:
samantha: Quick flag  noticed router is pinned to rtr-3.9.1 but runtime CI promoted rtm-3.10.0. Both landed in deploy-bot queue for 03:00 UTC. Router config expects legacy session header ordering. We need a plan.
deploy-bot: automated: Deploy scheduled 2026-04-20 03:00 UTC. Components: api=stable, runtime=rtm-3.10.0, router=rtr-3.9.1. Canary: 2% -> 10% -> 50%. To rollback runtime: /deploy rollback runtime rtm-3.9.9.
rick: Oof. rtm-3.10.0 has a change to session marshaling that flips header order. Router parsing is order-sensitive due to a legacy regex.
tuan: We can either unpin router, fast-track rtr-3.10, or make runtime present compatibility headers for one wave. Unpin requires product signoff.
elena: Product is OOO today until late afternoon. Not comfortable changing pins without them. Can we run compatibility shim in runtime?
samantha: Could runtime emit a fallback header "x-rwd-session-legacy" alongside the new ones for first canary wave? That avoids pin changes.
infra-ops: We can add a temporary router rule to accept either header order, but that change touches edge routers and needs an infra review. Review in progress, might finish by 02:20 UTC.
tuan: If infra can't finish, we should plan a conservative rollback. What's the failure mode from staging?
rick: In staging, 2% of auth requests got 400s when the router didn't find the legacy header first. No server crashes, just auth failures. Recovery quick after rollback.
eldeploy: (bot) Proposing canary variant: runtime=rtm-3.10.0 with feature-flag compat=true for first wave. Toggle: /feature runtime rtm-3.10.0 compat on/off.
elena: Good. Add a telemetry tag to auth responses so we can query header-related errors: rwd.header.mismatch.
samantha: Also set deploy-bot to pause between waves and require manual ack to proceed to 10%. No auto-roll.
deploy-bot: updated plan: canary 2% with compat=true, manual proceed to 10% and 50%. Abort conditions: >0.8% increase in 401/400 auth errors over baseline for 5 consecutive minutes.
infra-ops: Router accept-rule approved in staging; will attempt prod push at 02:05 UTC but will hold if any infra alerts.
tuan: I'll add a lightweight hotfix in runtime to emit the legacy header only for requests matching user-agent /^console\/.+/ so console flows continue.
rick: That limits exposure. Nice. Are we sure console UA matches that pattern?
tuan: Yes, console UA is "console/production". Verified.
elena: I'll draft release notes: "rtm-3.10.0: session marshaling update. Backward-compatibility emitted for console UAs during canary. Router pinned to 3.9.1; compatibility shim enabled for first wave. Rollback: /deploy rollback runtime rtm-3.9.9."
samantha: Let's rendezvous in #eng-releases at 02:40 UTC for preflight signoff. If infra can't push router rule, we default to rollback.
deploy-bot: preflight reminder set 02:40 UTC. Checklist: compat flag set, telemetry tag added, manual-step in canary, kill-switch thresholds configured.
rick: I'll be on-call for the window. If we see auth spike, issue /deploy rollback runtime rtm-3.9.9 and note incident.
infra-ops: Will post here once prod router rule is live or blocked.
elen a: tagging @product for visibility (they're OOO but will see thread). Keep updates short.
